scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:bun && npm run test:deno
scripts.clean: rm -rf build/parcel/* && rm -rf build/rollup/* && rm -rf build/webpack/* && rm -rf build/esbuild/*
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:parcel && npm run build:webpack && npm run build:rollup && npm run build:esbuild
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && npm run browser-tests
scripts.test:chromium: npm run build && npm run browser-tests:chromium
scripts.test:browsers: npm run build && npm run browser-tests:all
scripts.test:full: npm run test:all && npm run test:browsers
